test_title: SSC Selection Post Graduation Level Official Paper (Held on: 8 Feb 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: To do a certain work, A is 40% more efficient than B. Working together, they can do the same work in 15 days. A started the work and left after 15 days. B and C together completed the remaining work in next 10 days. C alone can do one-third of the original work in:
solution:
**Given:**

A is 40% more efficient than B

**Concept used:**

Time = Work/Efficiency

**Calculation:**

Let, A : B = 140 : 100 = 7 : 5

So, efficiency of A = 7 and efficiency of B = 5

The total work = (7 + 5) × 15 = 180

A complete in 15 days = 15 × 7 = 105 work

Remaining work = 180 - 105 = 75

Let, the efficiency of C = x

So, 75/(5 + x) = 10

⇒ 50 + 10x = 75

⇒ x = (75 - 50)/10 = 25/10 = 2.5

C will take time to complete one-third of the original work = (180/3)/2.5 = 24 days

**∴ C alone can do one-third of the original work in 24 days**
